content:
I think the build is broken for all PRs due to some caching issue? E.g. https://github.com/teorth/analysis/pull/493 fails, but the PR is very minimal, unlikely to be the culprit.

I don't fully understand the lake project build systems but at least Claude claims it is due to merging a number of PRs quickly, which cancelled previous runs but poisoned the cache.
I've deleted all the caches and am merging 493 to see if this fixes the problem. UPDATE: looks like it worked!
